messages:
alex: Quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #1426? It changes the quantized kernel selection and tweaks the LRU cache eviction window. I'm worried about a p99 regression in routing-heavy workloads.
kevin: on it, can you paste the perf numbers or a failing trace? :eyes:
alex: repro gist attached: https://gist.github.com/xxx (small summary below)
\nPerf summary before -> after (local perf harness):
- p50: 9ms -> 9.5ms
- p95: 28ms -> 30ms
- p99: 65ms -> 112ms  <-- spike
\nThe change is mostly in runtime/quant_kernels.cpp: kernel selector and a cache TTL bump from 30s -> 45s.
\nCode snippet:
```cpp
// selector heuristic
if (seq_len <= 128 && model_quant == Q4_0) {
  use_fused_attention = true;
} else {
  use_fused_attention = fallback;
}
```
maria: I'll take a pass this afternoon, but quick thought: increasing TTL could cause cache churn if we change eviction order semantics. Did you change key hashing anywhere?
sasha: CI perf-run showed the same p99 bump on the staging perf harness. Log excerpt:
```
2026-05-12T15:02:11Z [perf] batch=32 seq=256 p99=110ms
2026-05-12T15:02:11Z [perf] routing miss rate jumped 4.2% -> 9.7%
```
ci-bot: perf-check: PR #1426 — perf-harness: FAILED (p99 regression detected). See /ci/perf/1426
kevin: thx. alex — can you run the harness with `--cache-debug` and `--kernel-trace` so we can see eviction counts + kernel decisions?
alex: running now, will upload logs in ~10m.
maria: also flag: if fused attention path changes, please include a fallback correctness test for KV-cache alignment; that's a common subtlety.
alex: uploaded logs: https://internal-storage/artefacts/1426/logs.txt — eviction spikes coincide with routing bursts. Kernel trace shows switching between scalar and fused every ~20 steps.
sasha: that pattern could cause pipeline stalls and queueing, raising p99. Maybe add hysteresis to selector to avoid flip-flop.
kevin: agree — a simple debounce (e.g., require 3 consecutive samples before switching) might stabilize.
maria: I left 2 small comments on the PR (one style, one behavioral). Functionality looks fine but please add the perf harness flags and the debounce patch.
alex: thanks — pushed debounce change + harness flags in a follow-up commit. Triggered CI.
ci-bot: perf-check: PR #1426 — perf-harness: PASS (no regression). unit-tests: PASS.
maria: LGTM pending squash. small nit about a log message.
alex: squashed and addressed the log nit. planning to merge after branch-protection window (30m).
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2026-05-12T17:00Z if merge completes and CI stays green.
kevin: awesome, thanks team :tada:
alex: really appreciate the quick help — will watch the canary and report back if anything odd shows up.
